passive.name: Petricite Burst
passive.text: After casting a spell, Sylas stores a charge of Petricite Burst. Sylas's basic attacks will expend a charge and whirl his energized chains around him dealing bonus magic damage to enemies hit. While Sylas has a charge of Petricite Burst, he gains attack speed.

spells.name: Chain Lash
spells.text: Sylas lashes his chains out, intersecting at his targeted location dealing damage to and slowing enemies. After a delay, magical energy explodes from the intersection point dealing damage.

spells.name: Kingslayer
spells.text: Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing damage and healing himself against enemy champions.

spells.name: Abscond / Abduct
spells.text: Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.

spells.name: Hijack
spells.text: Sylas steals the enemy's ultimate ability and can cast it freely.

damage.value: Sylas deals burst magic damage with his chains and spells.

spikes.at: When Kingslayer's cooldown falls to 6 seconds
spikes.why: Sylas can use its damage and champion-only healing more often.
